content:
>be me  
>terminally lonely femboy  
>just want to hold this boy’s hand  
>not even asking for much bro  
>don’t need sex, don’t need drama, just pure, unfiltered, hand-holding.exe  

>imagine walking down the hallway  
>fingers interlocked  
>giggling like a little anime side character  
>lined up against the walls of public rejection like it’s a firing squad  
>people staring like I just drop-kicked a puppy  

>“wE dOn’T hAtE yOu wE jUsT dOn’T wAnT tO sEe It”  
>background NPCs making casual gay jokes like we’re some mythological creature  
>“bro that’s so gay lol”  
>hello yes I am right here, not a cryptid, can hear you  

>any chance of social life: obliterated.mp4  
>press X to come out of the cage and lose all your IRL side quests  
>family aggro, friends aggro, school aggro  
>all this because I wanna be a cute girly boy in thigh highs holding some dude’s hand  

>society.exe: “why are you like this”  
>me: “I like being a cute girly boy, what’s wrong with it?”  
>society.exe has stopped working  

>they hate us for loving  
>they love us for hating  
>that’s the actual clown world irony  

>mfw I just want soft hands, warm fingers, and a little squeeze  
>mfw instead I get lifelong ostracization DLC  
>mfw no bf to hold hands with in the hall and tank social aggro together  

>just let me be a cute girly boy and hold hands, you absolute NPCs  
>that’s it  
>that’s the post
